source: Hand-written rewards.py used for the checked-in GRPO runs (results/rl.json, results/rl2.json), expressed as a coach reward spec.

terms.name: score_delta
terms.why: Engine score: +10 pellet, -1 per move, -500 caught.

terms.name: food_progress
terms.why: Shaping: 2 points per maze step closer to the nearest pellet.

terms.name: ghost_adjacent
terms.why: Moving next to an active ghost.

terms.name: ghost_near
terms.why: Moving to two steps from an active ghost.
